How it works

Live everywhere in four steps.

Go from registering your masjid to live on every screen and phone in a single afternoon.

  1. Step 01

    Register your masjid

    Create your masjid in minutes. Completely free, no setup fees.

  2. Step 02

    Set your prayer & iqamah times

    Enter your official timetable and iqamah, your calculation method.

  3. Step 03

    Connect your screens & community

    Add your prayer-hall display and invite your community to the app.

  4. Step 04

    Every update goes live

    Change a time or post a notice and it updates everywhere at once.
